summary: "None of the pure compound": the passages name the component as a reactant, product, solvent or ligand, or give a value of a mixture or a solution. 176 gaps searched (the properties a calculation needs); 78 had at least one open article where a name of the component and the property appear in the same paragraph or table. Each such passage (the passage the script shows, and the article where it pointed to a value) was read on 2026-10-22. One measured value was found: solketal's vapour pressure (Türck et al. 2026), added with the maintainer's agreement, read off its figure and held to its uncertainty of 16-19 %. Europe PMC indexes the biomedical literature and the journals deposited in PubMed Central (MDPI, ACS Omega, RSC Advances, Scientific Reports); it does not have J. Chem. Eng. Data, J. Chem. Thermodyn., Fluid Phase Equilib. or Int. J. Thermophys., where most measurements are, so OpenAlex was asked too, later the same day, with a key. Neither index found a further value usable under the rules: the melting points of DL-malic acid and cis,cis-muconic acid came without an enthalpy of fusion.

indexes.Europe PMC: asked (full texts of open-access articles; 8 articles read per search)
indexes.OpenAlex: asked, with a key (a network secret of the environment): one full-text query per gap, open-access works only, 8 articles per query; 1185 articles found, 271 of them could be downloaded as a PDF and read (the others' servers refuse scripts or give no PDF)
indexes.CORE: not asked: the maintainer has written to CORE to ask which licence fits an MIT-licensed simulator (2026-10-22)
